subject: general
question: How many Indian states & Union territory does NH-44 cross?
solution:
The correct answer is __**12**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• NH-44 is the longest National Highway in India, stretching from Srinagar in Jammu & Kashmir to Kanyakumari in Tamil Nadu.
 
• It passes through 12 states and Union Territories, which include Jammu & Kashmir, Himachal Pradesh, Punjab, Haryana, Delhi, Uttar Pradesh, Madhya Pradesh, Maharashtra, Telangana, Andhra Pradesh, Karnataka, and Tamil Nadu.
 
• The total length of NH-44 is approximately 3,745 kilometers.
 
• This highway plays a crucial role in connecting the northern and southern parts of India, facilitating trade and travel across the country.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **National Highway (NH)**

 
 
• National Highways are the primary roadways that connect various states and major cities across India.
 
• They are maintained by the National Highways Authority of India (NHAI) and the Ministry of Road Transport and Highways.
 
• National Highways constitute about 2% of India's total road network but carry about 40% of the road traffic.
 
• They are essential for the economic development and connectivity of the country, reducing travel time and fuel consumption.
 
 
 
• **National Highway 44 (NH-44)**
 
 
• NH-44 was previously known as NH-7 before the renumbering of national highways in 2010.
 
• It is the longest National Highway in India, spanning from north to south.
 
• NH-44 covers a diverse range of geographical terrains and climates, from the cold mountains of Jammu & Kashmir to the tropical coasts of Tamil Nadu.
 
• It is a critical route for the transportation of goods and passengers, promoting regional and national integration.
 
 
 
• **Importance of NH-44**
 
 
• NH-44 plays a significant role in the economic development of the regions it passes through by improving connectivity and reducing transportation costs.
 
• It enhances access to markets, education, and healthcare services for the people living in remote areas.
 
• It supports tourism by providing better access to tourist destinations along its route.
 
• The highway also boosts industrial growth by facilitating the movement of raw materials and finished goods.
